snippet.title: Aadhi Khajoor Bhi Kaafi Hai? | Bukhari 1417 | Chhota Sadqah, Bari Dhaal #shorts
snippet.description:
Kya aap ke paas sadqah dene ko kuch nahin? Agar sirf aadhi khajoor ho, to?

Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ('Adi bin Hatim Radi Allahu Anhu se riwayat):
«اتَّقُوا النَّارَ وَلَوْ بِشِقِّ تَمْرَةٍ»
"Aag se bacho, chahe aadhi khajoor ke zariye hi sahi."

Reference
• Sahih al-Bukhari 1417: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:1417

Kam ko kam mat samjhein. Aaj kisi bhooke ko ek luqma khilayein, ek khajoor hi sahi. Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
